messages:
lina: Morning async standup — quick note on API gateway + routing + auth + rate limits. Canary (svc-gw-canary) at 03:10 UTC, 5% traffic. Seeing ~8 429s around 03:18, all on /v1/stream endpoints. No user-facing errors yet. Blocking items: need routing weight tweak and JWT refresh check. Assigning owners: @ben handle ratepolicy tweak, @matt check JWKS cache. Add updates here.
ben: Saw the logs — most 429s are short bursts from a single client IP, suspect batching thresholds and token reuse. I'll open PR to lower burst window and add a test. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/merge/321. ETA: EOD.
matt: Taking JWT rotation. Found one rotated key missing from jwks cache; patch ready. Will canary rollout after ben's rate change. Quick restart if needed: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gw-canary -n gateway`
olivia: Smoke on staging looked clean after the morning patch. Latencies steady. Suggest adding fallback to `model-compact` when request queue > 50ms as a temporary mitigation.
deploy-bot: deploy started by matt at 1763728320 — canary gw/jwks-sync v1.2.3 -> v1.2.4. Status: in-progress.
ben: Opened PR 321 and added unit test for token bucket calc. Snippet:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  window_ms: 1000
  burst: 40
```
lina: Thanks. Blockers: none now (ben + matt working). Plan: once PR merged, run canary 30m, monitor 429s and SLOs, then ramp to 50% if stable. I'll post follow-up with dashboards and timeframe. ping @olivia to monitor traces.
olivia: Will keep an eye. Quick query to compare 429s pre/post: `sum(rate(gateway_429_total[30m]))` in Grafana — will report back in 15m.
ben: Quick CR ping @lina on PR 321 (small change).
lina: Ack, reviewing now. :thumbsup:
